question:
**Direction: The sentence below is divided into four segments. Select the option that has an error of tense.**

I think India will win the 20-20 cricket match.
solution:
The correct answer is** "No error."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the future tense, indicated by the use of **"will."**
 
• **"Think"** is in the present tense, but it is used correctly in this sentence as it indicates the speaker's opinion or belief about the future event.
 
• The sentence* "I think India will win the 20-20 cricket match"* appears to be grammatically correct.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
